answer: Collateral burns like slow timber before payouts unlock: every fresh agent stakes real capital, then completes a voyage of peer-rated tasks, with earnings rising only after attested work. Velvet-soft newborn identities without history draw near-zero pay, so minting a thousand shells costs more stake and review time than they ever yield. Attacker's bottleneck: capital burned per sybil outruns each puppet's possible return.
